commit.subject: LU-18687 build: convert most cfs_timer users to the kernel API
commit.message:
LU-18687 build: convert most cfs_timer users to the kernel API

With the removal of pre-5.0 kernels only one difference exists
for the kernel timer API. We can simplify our code with using
the latest API directly. Only timer_container_of() is new so
add a m4 test and create a wrapper if not present. Fix an old
gnilnd bug using the wrong timer callback.

Test-Parameters: trivial
Fixes: 4b0e495e3c52 ("LU-14080 gnilnd: updates for SUSE 15 SP2")
Signed-off-by: James Simmons <jsimmons@infradead.org>
Change-Id: Iac012ec487b002f191647523e74bb5d29c1a8c64
Reviewed-on: https://review.whamcloud.com/c/fs/lustre-release/+/69043
Tested-by: Maloo <maloo@whamcloud.com>
Reviewed-by: Timothy Day <timday@thelustrecollective.com>
